input.whatISee: The second look shows no overlapping boxes and every label is crisp on its dark plate against the dusk meadow in both orientations. The fork reads clearly: Monster Chase swings high, Word Puzzle dips low, both rejoining at Spelling Checkpoint before the glowing final path to the Mastery Gate. A few landscape gaps are 12–21px instead of 28px, but visually nothing crowds — the near pairs sit diagonally so orbs and plates stay clear of each other, and all stops avoid the level badge, status bar and Elli. Since this was my last look, I adjust the tightest landscape pairs a touch for extra air — choice to (0.55, 0.54), Hidden Letters Practice to (0.42, 0.16), Sneaky C Sounds to (0.29, 0.65), end to (0.97, 0.08) — and submit.
input.pattern: winding river with a forked delta
input.rationale: The journey is a river that winds left to right across the meadow hills, rising and dipping like a child's finger tracing an adventure. At the choice the river splits into a true delta — Monster Chase leaps up toward the hilltops while Word Puzzle flows through the valley — and the two dashed branches rejoin at the Spelling Checkpoint before the glowing final stretch to the Spelling Mastery Gate. Dashed branches mark 'your choice', solid the main river, and the glow saves the biggest sparkle for the finish. The dusk theme's dark plates keep every label readable over the bright illustrated world, and all stops stay clear of the level badge, status bar and Elli.
